svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Legs: two 843 mm lengths of 28 x 1.5 mm tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Grip: 520 mm of 32 x 1.5 mm tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lay out on the bench: leg feet 560 mm apart, leg tops 480 mm apart,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: meeting the grip 20 mm in from each grip end. Fish-mouth the leg

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tops to the grip and weld.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each leg drops into a socket on the rail end, 30.5 degrees up from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: level; mark the leg 115 mm from its foot and drill 8.5 mm across it

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with the leg in the socket, through the socket's pin hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Quick-release pins hold the handle; pull them to take it off.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Grip 900 mm above the ground, 1,270 mm from the deck centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the handle drops in and out of both sockets without forcing.
